PVC is a synthetic thermoplastic prepared by addition polymerization of vinyl chloride. Rigid PVC is used in pipes, while plasticized PVC is flexible and suitable for electrical and medical applications. Buna-S is a synthetic elastomer prepared from butadiene and styrene. Polyacetylene possesses conjugated double bonds, and doping enhances its conductivity. Biodegradable polymers degrade through the action of microorganisms. Polylactic acid (PLA) is used in packaging and biomedical applications.
